visualizations.name: The minimal cell sustains itself (autopoietic closure)

config.caption: Time series of the runnable fig08 minimal cell (fig08-runnable): the six coupled processes — containment, metabolism, gene-expression, replication, diffusion and reactions — wired over flat scalar building-block pools. Because they share those pools they mutually produce the components that sustain each other: the catalytic/template pools (genes, energy, metabolites, nucleic acids) hold a SUSTAINED steady balance while the cell's structural material (membrane, proteins, enzymes) is net-produced — nothing collapses to zero, nothing explodes. This is autopoietic closure made runnable. From scripts/build_fig08_dynamics.py.

question: How does a minimal cell coarse-grain into a self-organized process?
